title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-jl
content:
Weekly prep notes for dedicated capacity sync (personal scratchpad)

Meeting: Dedicated capacity weekly sync / prep for 1:1 with Ava
Date: 2026-03-04 weekly sync (prep dated 2026-02-27, updated 2026-03-03)
Attendees (expect): Ava, Samir, Maya, Infra on-call (TBD)

Goal: quick run-through of pool utilization, upcoming reservation requests, autoscaling anomalies, and action items. Leave with 3 concrete asks for infra/product.

Agenda (rough)
- Quick numbers (30s)
  - current committed GPUs (prod reserved): 120 A100s equivalent across dedicated-pool-1/2
  - current avg utilization (last 7d): 68% overall; peak 92% (2026-03-01 14:10 UTC)
  - burst usage last week: +18% due to batch eval job (internal eval-run JIRA-4599)
- Upcoming reservation requests (2m)
  - Marketing demo (Mar 15-18): request +8 GPUs (g4dn?) -> need cost estimate + fallback plan
  - Large customer POC (enterprise): expected to request 40 GPUs starting Apr 1 (2-week validation)
- Autoscaling behavior and oddities (3m)
  - Observed: scale-down sometimes delays 12-18 minutes after idle window -> leads to extra spend
  - Hypothesis: cooldown config vs KV cache draining; check graceful shutdown hook timing
  - Recent fix (PR#812) aimed to improve drain; need to validate in staging for 48h
- Model mix / kernel concerns (2m)
  - New Llama2-70B-mix quantized profile causes 20% higher mem pressure -> affects per-GPU tenancy
  - Consider creating separate pool for large-32k runs or enforce model-specific routing
- Cost forecast & suggestions (2m)
  - If POC (40 GPUs) starts Apr1 and runs full month -> incremental GPU hours ~ 40*24*30 = 28.8k hours; estimate monthly cost +$XXk (rough, need billing join)
  - Suggest soft reservations + burstable capacity instead of full commit for first month
- Action review (2m)
  - Follow-ups from last week: Maya to validate PR#812 in staging (status: in-progress)
  - Samir to provide exact peak timestamps and job ids for Mar1 spike (status: done)

Notes / scratch thoughts
- Need a clearer definition of "idle window" for autoscaler: currently 5min low CPU + 1 active request = not considered idle. That 5min may be too aggressive for low-latency apps.
- For KV-cache heavy workloads (chat long contexts) scale-down should wait for KV flush or risk rewarm penalty. Add metric: "cache-hit after scale"?
- Reservation workflow pain points: product teams request via form -> PO -> finance clearance -> infra provision. Could we add a 2-step temp reservation (soft reserve) to reduce approval friction?

Rough numbers / forecasts (back-of-envelope)
- Baseline committed: 120 GPUs (A100 equiv)
- Avg utilization: 68% -> roughly 81 GPUs active average
- Buffer target for 95p SLA: +25% = 101 GPUs needed to hit peak SLOs comfortably
- Expected near-term increases:
  - Marketing demo +8 GPUs (short lived)
  - POC enterprise +40 GPUs (Apr) -> if approved, we need temporary 40 GPU capacity + autoscale rules to evict noncritical batch jobs
- Autoscaling config suggestion:
  - scale-up threshold: 85% consolidation per GPU for 2 consecutive minutes
  - scale-down cooldown: 10 minutes idle + KV-cache drain flag cleared
  - max-burst: 30% over reserved commit (auto-burst to dedicated-burst-pool)

Open questions to bring up in sync
- Can infra add a metric for "KV cache entries needing rewarm" or a boolean drain-in-progress per instance? (ask infra)
- Can finance support a 30-day soft reservation with delayed billing to accommodate POC? (ask finance/product)
- For model routing: is it feasible to tag jobs by model-size and enforce scheduling to large-instance pool? (ask serving-runtime)

Concrete asks for this meeting (3 asks)
1) Samir/Ava: confirm whether we can enable PR#812 in staging for 48h validation and then schedule prod deploy if green. Need explicit owner and ETA (Maya is on it).
2) Infra: add a "drain_in_progress" metric or expose KV-cache drain state to autoscaler (priority: high).
3) Product/Finance: approve a soft reservation path (30-day trial reserve) for POC so infra can pre-warm without immediate full commit.

Follow-ups / action items (personal tracking)
- [ ] Maya Chen: validate PR#812 in staging, post results in #infra-status by EOD 2026-03-05 (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Jordan Lee (me): compile billing rough estimate for 40 GPU POC and drop in #capacity-discuss by 2026-03-06
- [ ] Samir Patel: paste job ids/timestamps for Mar1 spike into this doc (done but ensure included) -> DONE 2026-03-02
- [ ] Ava Martinez: run through demo reservation ask with GTM and confirm exact GPU type by 2026-03-07

Quick past notes snapshot (for 1:1)
- Last week we saw a persistent 12min scale-down lag; infra suspects container drain timing. Maya working on a fix (PR#812).
- Customer POC pipeline still targeting Apr1 but might slip a week -> keep soft reserve option open.

Misc quick todo (notes to self)
- Ask infra for a CSV export of daily GPU hours by pool (last 60 days) before the meeting.
- Add a short runbook for demo reservations (template email + cost calc)

End of notes. Keep this doc as a living scratchpad; convert to a shareable one-pager if we need to loop in product/finance.
